items.name: First-party event capture
items.reason: A privacy-minimized deterministic event normalization contract exists, but no physical first-party capture/persistence path is activated. This is a real zero-cost gap to extend EVT-001 through FACT-001 without buying an analytics service or creating a new engine.

items.name: PostHog
items.reason: Free-tier/self-host candidate only. The local first-party path is preferred; no PostHog project/runtime is activated and no automatic spend is permitted.

items.name: Talivia
items.reason: Paid revenue-attribution service. Patterns can be studied, but introducing a paid dependency conflicts with the zero-cost default while local first-party analytics remains viable.

items.name: Microsoft Clarity
items.reason: Free provider candidate, but activation is consent/privacy gated and no tag is deployed. Keep catalogued until a measured gap requires it and the privacy gate is green.

items.name: Yandex Metrica
items.reason: Although free, activation remains privacy/legal/DPA/consent gated. No tag is deployed and local first-party capture should be preferred first.

items.name: Company visitor identification
items.reason: Exact known-account or explicit first-party company-domain planning is implemented with company-only matching. No person resolution, fingerprinting or covert deanonymization is allowed.

items.name: Visited-page intent score
items.reason: Deterministic page-category account intent scoring exists over normalized consented events; it remains partial until a physical first-party event source is active.

items.name: Return-visit signal
items.reason: Deterministic return-visit derivation exists with no device fingerprinting. It remains partial pending a physical event source.

items.name: CRM + website event merge
items.reason: Read-only exact account/domain timeline merge is implemented with no fuzzy person matching and no CRM writes. Physical persistence/event ingestion remains outside this item-level claim.
